entries.name: The New Tetris
entries.sourceDocument: Original Nintendo of America instruction booklet, digital pages3/4, printed pages2/5; scanned images visually read.
entries.finding: Multiplayer menu explicitly permits two, three or four humans with independent controllers; printed page5 lists Marathon, Ultra and Lines. Sprint belongs to Single list and is not imported as a multiplayer mode.
requirements: Each human requires its own standard N64 controller socket; port1 cannot be empty
Player names selected in Multi Player
Controller Pak optional only for profile transfer, not a mandatory multiplayer dependency

entries.name: Star Wars Episode I - Racer
entries.sourceDocument: LucasArts/Lucasfilm original Nintendo64 manual, digital page14 MODE DEUX JOUEURS; Nintendo original product page.
entries.finding: Attach the second controller, choose 2 JOUEURS, choose each podracer and a course; race uses one half-screen per human. The adjacent Options section only requires Expansion Pak for high resolution, not for the base two-player mode.
requirements: No PC eight-player mode or dual-controller cheat imported
High resolution optional and requires Expansion Pak

entries.name: WinBack - Covert Operations
entries.sourceDocument: Original Koei instruction booklet, digital page6/printed10-11 MODES; digital4/printed6-7 standard controller actions.
entries.finding: Original Versus rules distinguish the capacity of six modes: DeathMatch2-4; LethalTag/CubeHunt/QuickDraw/TeamBattle2; PointMatch3-4. A general four-player label must not make every mode accept four. Story remains one player.
requirements: Independent standard N64 controller per human; original C/R/Z/analog actions
Do not infer two-player availability for Point Match or four-player availability for Team Battle

reviewPolicy: Original publisher manuals visually inspected; documentary facts do not assert server activation or physical gameplay.
